rationale: The target exactly formalizes the selected algebraic passage from simultaneous Euclidean column bounds to a Frobenius bound. Its norm definitions, gamma_tilde formula, coefficient c6 lambda sqrt(n) gamma_tilde_m(lambda), positivity of lambda, simultaneous finite-column quantification, inequality direction, and additive second-order remainder all match the PDF. It introduces no extra sqrt(n). By making O(u^2) explicit and proving the implication for arbitrary finite real matrices and positive natural c6, it is broader than the paper's QR-context statement, hence faithful-stronger rather than strictly equivalent. The omitted Householder algorithm, backward-factorization relation, rounding model, and probability are outside this selected standalone implication and remain necessary for any claim to formalize the enclosing Theorem 4.4.
